newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: KALNAPILIS APRIL OUTPUT UP LESS THAN EXPECTED.
newsitem.headline: KALNAPILIS APRIL OUTPUT UP LESS THAN EXPECTED.

text.p: Lithuania's Kalnapilis brewery said on Tueday its production volume rose in April to 211,000 decalitres compared to 200,000 decalitres a month before.
But director general of the company Lionginas Mackevichius told Reuters that he was not happy with the volume rise.
"We are absolutely dissatisfied with our sales volume this month which was not as high as we would like to because of the cold spring this year," Mackevichius added.
He also said that the company expects to double the sales volume of its products during the summer months.
Kalnapilis is listed on the A group of Vilnius bourse. It is owned by Baltic Beverages, itself a joint venture of Hartwall and Pripps, part of Norway's Orkla .
It today registered a share capital boost to 25.4 million litas from 8.47 million litas from company reserves and renewed its trade on the Vilnius bourse today.
